### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>klauspost/compress (github.com/klauspost/compress)</summary>

### [`v1.20.3`](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/releases/tag/v1.20.3)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.2...v1.20.3)

#### What's Changed

- zstd: two-pass decode with match-source prefetch on arm64 (largest win decoding SpeedBestCompression-class data) by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1212](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1212)
- zstd: speed up better encoder hashing, primes in registers on arm64 by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1230](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1230)
- zstd: reuse dictionary sequence tables in the encoder by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1233](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1233)
- zstd: close most of the decode gap to libzstd on real corpora by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1232](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1232)
- huff0: align the decode inner loops to 64 bytes by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1236](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1236)
- zstd: keep default-encoder hash primes in registers on arm64 by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1241](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1241)
- zstd: align the sequence decode and execute loops to 64 bytes by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1240](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1240)
- zstd, huff0: cheaper per-block table setup by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1234](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1234)
- zstd, s2, flate: smoke-test Silesia in CI, add real-corpus benchmarks by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1237](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1237)
- zip: reject entries named "." in ReadDir to stop infinite fs.WalkDir by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1249](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1249)
- zstd: decode at full speed into exact-size destinations by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1246](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1246)
- s2: Reject short index chunk in RemoveIndexHeaders by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1254](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1254)
- zstd, huff0: keep the encoder bit writers in registers by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1245](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1245)
- huff0: reuse Scratch across inputs in the fuzzers by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1257](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1257)

#### New Contributors

- [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) made their first contribution in [#​1235](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1235)
- [@​SulimanAbdulrazzaq](https://redirect.github.com/SulimanAbdulrazzaq) made their first contribution in [#​1255](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1255)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.1...v1.20.3>

### [`v1.20.2`](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/releases/tag/v1.20.2)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.1...v1.20.2)

- zstd: Fix DecodeAll crash on specially crafted input. [GHSA-fpmh-frq8-7rj8](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/security/advisories/GHSA-fpmh-frq8-7rj8).
- s2: fix LZ4 block conversion writing past dst by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1244](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1244)
- dict: Stricter input validation by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1250](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1250)
- zstd: reject snappy copy shorter than minimum match by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1235](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1235)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.1...v1.20.2>

</details>
